name: Akizuki Ryou
source:
A genius elite who stands at the top of the Akizuki group, one of the largest in the Japanese business world.
He is a self-confident person who aims to be at the top of the Japanese business world and has no doubt about his success.
He has a big attitude like me, but the statement itself makes sense.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/ryo_akizuki.html]official website[/url]]
